name: pstore_native

efi_module_load.rationale: The safeguard persists the Linux EFI pstore module load.

erst_module_load.rationale: The safeguard persists the Linux ERST pstore module load.

storage.rationale: Linux-only module-load configuration is verified by the handler's module seam.

description: Activate native kernel pstore backends (efi_pstore / erst) so panic dumps survive resets without modifying GRUB
